title: Agent Slim layout description
description: Optional file that tells the audit where an agent keeps its resident context, skills, sessions and logs. Every path is relative to the audited home. Omitting a field falls back to the vendor defaults.

host.description: Label reported in audit output; use whatever the agent calls itself.

hot.description: Files injected every turn or at startup. This is the layer whose reduction shows up in per-turn token cost.

oneOf.description: Shorthand for {path, category: instructions, loadedWhen: every-turn}.

path.description: Home-relative path. Absolute paths and '..' segments are rejected.

category.description: Grouping only; it does not change which actions are allowed.

loadedWhen.description: Free-form trigger label, e.g. every-turn or startup-memory-summary.

skillRoots.description: Directories scanned for SKILL.md-like entries. Defaults to ["skills"].

ruleRoots.description: Directories whose markdown files may be pulled in by a resident rule file. Defaults to ["rules"].

sessionRoots.description: Cold-layer conversation directories. Counted as disk only, never as token savings.

backupRoots.description: Directories holding duplicate backups. Only byte-identical duplicates can be quarantined without per-item confirmation.
